presentation.label: EUCLIDEAN SCALE
presentation.summary: Keep stock Euclidean audio notes in the current keyboard scale and reroll their pitches.
presentation.overview: Enable scale follow per pattern and audio track, then reroll the pitches while the stock sequencer plays the rhythm.
highlights: Rerolled notes repeat on later loops.
Set independent low and high octave bounds.
usage: Press FUNC + KEYBOARD and set the pattern root and scale, for example C Ionian.
Select an audio track. Press FUNC + AMP, enable EUC and set the pulse count. Press FUNC + AMP again to reach the Scale page.
Turn encoder A clockwise for SCF. Start playback and press encoder B for RNN. Listen to the next loop, then turn A counterclockwise to clear the reroll and hear the original pitches.
Turn C counterclockwise for a lower LO and D clockwise for a higher HI. Press B again to hear another melody inside the selected range.

steps: Press FUNC + AMP to open Euclidean and enable EUC on the selected audio track.
Press FUNC + AMP again to open Euclidean Scale.
Turn A for SCF, press B for RNN, and turn C and D for the lowest and highest octaves. Press FUNC + AMP or NO to return.

controls.name: SCF
controls.doc: Turn A clockwise to snap the default pitches to the pattern's keyboard scale. Turning A counterclockwise clears the reroll for this track.

controls.name: RNN
controls.doc: Enables SCF and rerolls a repeating melody inside the octave bounds, or within six semitones of the quantized pitch in AUTO.

controls.name: LO
controls.doc: Turn C to set the lowest octave relative to the scale root nearest the track note. Press to reset both bounds to AUTO.

controls.name: HI
controls.doc: Turn D to set the highest octave relative to the same root. Press to reset both bounds to AUTO.

limitations: Stock Euclidean audio tracks only. Explicit trig overrides pass through.
Project saves restore SCF, rerolls and octave bounds with the same kit-data layout. Earlier K117 trial settings reset on upgrade.

load.display: Digikit peak: 268 instructions for ranged RNN
load.conditions: 44,392 direct ColdFire callback calls with interrupts masked. This excludes the stock bridge and hardware scheduling. Physical maximum load was outside the test.

hardware.summary: Author reported the O117 hardware trial passed. The requested trial covered boot, a root-only reroll at LO and HI zero, and save and reload with LO minus one and HI plus two.
limitations: Functional trial. Physical timing and maximum-track load were outside the test.

tests.summary: Repeat pinned builds, 44,392 ColdFire pitch checks, Digikit save and reload, and the author's O117 hardware trial.
